title: FRACMATH: A vectorized MATLAB framework for continuum damage mechanics with crack band regularization
description: FRACMATH is an inspectable MATLAB framework for quasibrittle fracture with scalar continuum damage and direction-dependent Oliver crack-band regularization. The SoftwareX study provides material-point verification, a controlled three-mesh regularization comparison, structural energy diagnostics, increment checks, and single-CPU Abaqus job records. The 3D examples illustrate damage workflows qualitatively. The evidence does not establish a solver-speed ranking or GPU performance.
